summary: Postmortem addressing Thursday's database connection outage. The team identified the root cause as a new microservice lacking connection pooling and agreed on auto-rollback policies.
decisions: Any deployment causing a spike in errors will be automatically rolled back
risks: Connection limit on the database might still be too low given recent growth
completed_work: Sam wrote the incident report for our enterprise customers yesterday
